title: Classical violin, harmony and theory lessons at home
summary: Sanborn taught concertos, harmony and theory at the house until Wilson reached high school.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Well, your teacher, Mr. Sanborn, did he teach you the classical literature?
Yes. Oh, yeah, I was into concertos, and everything. I took harmony and theory.
And this is all before you went to high school?
This is all before I went to high school, yeah. I was still in the grade school.
Where did you take your lessons at?
-- music professor. How long did you study?
Oooooohh! I studied until I got in the high school.
